items.html: And there, in those posteriors, since there are many Klipot there — the waste (Pasolets) exceeding the food — the external ones (Chitzonim) have a hold there, both between those posteriors and between the attached ones. And they are the secret of "other gods" (Elohim Acherim) — meaning gods attached to the posteriors. And these are in Assiya, for in Beria Ima nests there, and she is the secret of the Name HaVaYaH with the vocalization of Elohim. But here, in Assiya, they are the secret of "other gods," as above.
